title: Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude
abstract: arXiv:2611.20953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. translated_title: 相同的修复，不同的权重：使用 Claude 复现权重空间编程
translated_abstract: Takehi 等人（2026）报告称，GPT-6 Astra 在以文本形式接收小型神经网络的权重时，能够说出这些网络被训练来做什么、修复它们，并在无需训练的情况下编写新的网络。我在十个预先注册的实验中使用 Claude Opus 5.5 重新运行了该研究的核心部分，实验包含未训练网络和置换对照组，并对每个沙盒代码单元进行了人工审计。权重阅读能力的结果喜忧参半：Claude 从策略权重中识别出了 4 个 Atari 游戏中的 3 个，并在 15/15 次字符级语言模型运行中都找到了被测量的复制头，但其关于训练数据的回答往往受先验知识影响。与原研究不同的是，它在 6/6 次运行中仅凭权重就识别出了一个谄媚的 Gemma 3 270M 微调模型。一次性权重编辑将一个失败的 MountainCar 策略从 0% 成功率提升到 100%，将一个悬停不动的 LunarLander 策略从 0% 提升到 85.6%；零样本编写的网络在 5 个环境中的 4 个上于 10 万步时击败了 PPO，且每个网络都实现了一个教科书式的控制器。在没有任何训练或前向传播的情况下，Claude 写……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在十个预注册实验中用 Claude Opus 5.5 复现了“权重空间编程”研究，证明大模型可以直接读写以文本形式呈现的神经网络权重——凭权重识别游戏与谄媚微调模型、一次性修复失败策略，并零样本编写出在多数环境上胜过训练十万步 PPO 的网络。
en_tdlr: This paper replicates weight-space programming with Claude Opus 5.5 across ten pre-registered experiments, showing that a large language model can directly read, repair, and write neural network weights given as text — identifying tasks and sycophantic finetunes from weights alone, one-shot fixing failing policies, and zero-shot writing networks that beat PPO on 4 of 5 environments.
